english.title: Company subject to creditors voluntary winding up fail to give information in notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a company registered in England and Wales which was subject to a creditors' voluntary winding up, without reasonable excuse failed, within the notice of the creditors meeting required under section 98(1A) of the Insolvency Act 1986 to state either the name and address of a person qualified to act as an insolvency practitioner in relation to the company who, during the period before the day on which that meeting was to be heard, would furnish creditors free of charge with such information concerning the company's affairs as they may reasonably require or a place in the relevant locality where, on the two business days falling next before the day on which that meeting was to be held, a list of the names and addresses of the company's creditors would be available for inspection free of charge
english.legislation: Contrary to section 98(2) and (6) of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
